summary.text: Wonda Johnson, listed by Ballotpedia as Doreen Wonda Johnson, is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico who has represented House District 5 since January 1, 2015, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Johnson earned a B.A. from Marymount University in 2009.

Her professional experience includes serving as an intergovernmental liaison and consultant for special projects in the Arizona State Governor's Office from 1992 to 2003, as a convention and events director for the National Indian Education Association from 2004 to 2011, and as an executive staff assistant in the Navajo Nation office of the president and vice president from 2011 to 2013.
